title: Immunofluorescence Analysis of Myosin Heavy Chain Isoforms
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iwjcfcn
materials: The slides were allowed to reach room temperature.
Primary antibodies in 1% NGS-PBS (1:100) were applied at 4°C overnight.
Secondary antibodies in 1% NGS-PBS (1:500) were applied for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Section muscle and mount
steps.instruction: Cut frozen muscle sections of 5 mm thickness using a cryostat and place them onto microscope slides.

steps.title: Permeabilize slides
steps.instruction: Incubate the slides in 0.3 % Triton X‑100 in PBS for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Apply a blocking solution consisting of 5 % normal goat serum in PBS and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash slides
steps.instruction: Wash the slides three times with PBS, each wash lasting 5 minutes.
